data.name: ViveTool_PageDescription
data.value: Maamul calaamadaha astaanta ee Windows iyadoo la isticmaalayo ViVeTool. Ku dhaqaaj ama ka jooji awoodaha tijaabada ah ee Windows.

data.name: ViveTool_WarningMessage
data.value: Khatar sare: beddelidda calaamadaha astaanta ee Windows waxay burburin kartaa Windows Update-ka, codsiyada (apps), darawallada (drivers), iyo xasilloonida nidaamka. Abuur goob soo celin ah marka hore. Ku dooro oo kaliya Feature IDs-yada la qeexay. Qaar ka mid ah beddeladaha waxay u baahan yihiin dib u bilow, waxaana laga yaabaa in aysan dib loo soo celin karin iyado aan la hayn keydi (backup).
